name: Shock Field
primary:
An electric field that shocks everyone inside.
A zone at the aim point with a 4-block radius for 8 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning + 1.25 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 2.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
